scope: All 10 research backend test modules, full frontend test suite, production build, real authenticated Studio activity/reload/reopen in Chromium and Firefox.
fixture: The real supervisor consumes deterministic loopback HTTP SSE output and persists the genuine incomplete-body failure. Source gathering/model output are simulated; planning is approved through the real DB transition before browser navigation.
expect: Identical failure and one source on both refs; validated report 0 -> 755 chars, incomplete label and every report paragraph visible after reload/reopen only with fix.
harness_correction: First Chromium capture read the DOM before deferred Markdown painted. The harness now awaits all report paragraphs and has delayed-render and missing-report controls. No product code was changed.
result: positive browser run succeeded; negative failed only the REPORT_RETENTION assertions in both browsers
visual_inspection: All four published 1440x1000 original before/after screenshots inspected; expected report difference visible in Chromium and Firefox. Byte-equivalent screenshot guard passed.
negative_macos_retry: Initial run also hit existing time-sensitive batching assertion (3 vs 2 writes); unchanged exact-job retry produced only the 4 expected interruption failures.
